verdict.summary: Round 2 finds no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. The test pins all three current module-level compiled worker issue head-ref regexes to the canonical byte string, checks meaningful admission boundary cases, AST-discovers undeclared and stale literal re.compile copies within its explicitly documented scope, includes anti-vacuity coverage, and verifies unconditional CI wiring. The production declarations match the declared set. Local execution was unavailable only because this checkout lacks PyYAML; the workflow context documents PyYAML as installed by shared setup, so that is not a PR defect. Findings are unchanged from round 1, hence progress is stagnant under the required scale.
